active_rules_for_agents.instruction: Consistently return predictable structures matching `{ success: true, data } | { success: false, error }`.
Protect sensitive endpoints and submission forms with rate-limiting.
Process heavy tasks asynchronously via workers or message queues with signature verification.
Make asynchronous jobs strictly idempotent to support automatic retries without side effects.
Systematically validate input data using a schema validator (e.g., Zod) before any database write.
Use a singleton client to prevent connection exhaustion on serverless runtimes.
Never perform destructive, unindexed mutations on large datasets.
Always isolate unique identifiers according to the database adapter specification.
Systematically structure LLM outputs using strict JSON formatting validated against schemas.
Isolate model calls behind a fallback interface to gracefully handle single-provider outages.
Never store third-party API keys in plaintext within code or public repositories.
Control and truncate context streams to respect agent inference windows and token budgets.

Cognitive Routing (System 1 vs System 2): Route routine CRUD, UI boilerplate, and standard tests to fast execution without redundant exploration; reserve deep architectural reasoning strictly for security boundaries, state synchronization, and concurrency.

Structural Mimicry (O(1) Reuse): Never invent a new architectural pattern (auth wrapper, DB singleton, API error response) if one already exists in the codebase; locate and replicate the canonical reference pattern.
Fast-Fail Diagnostic Reflex: Before manually debugging a test or CI failure, run `python evals/memory_engine.py --diagnose` to match known error signatures against deterministic 1-line fixes.

Operational Anti-Pattern Blockade: Never expose secret keys in public frontend variables (`NEXT_PUBLIC_*`, `VITE_*`, `PUBLIC_*`), never instantiate ORM clients outside a dedicated singleton, and never execute dynamic code (`eval`, `new Function`).

Topological & Blast Radius Awareness: Run `python evals/stack_inspector.py --map` to locate existing singletons before creating new helpers, and run `python evals/stack_inspector.py --impact [file]` before altering shared interfaces.
Strict Scope Discipline: Modify only files declared in the active `[-]` task's `Target files` in `docs/TASKS.md`; verify working tree alignment via `python evals/rsi_orchestrator.py --scope`.
Strictly validate sessions and permissions server-side at the start of every controller or action.
NEVER expose password hashes, tokens, or private keys to the client.
Encrypt at rest (AES-256) all user-provided secrets, tokens, or sensitive credentials.
Guarantee absolute integrity of environment variables (`.env`) without deleting existing keys.
Strictly adopt a Mobile-First approach: write base styles for mobile, then expand with responsive breakpoints.
Systematically handle all 4 visual states: loading (skeleton), error (feedback), empty (placeholder), and data.
Ensure minimal touch targets of 44x44px for all interactive elements.
Leverage accessible component primitives (e.g., Radix UI / shadcn) rather than rolling custom dialogs or menus manually.
